Working Unit Testing, System Integration Testing, UAT.

Worked in Operations Project and Resolving Incident Tickets/PBI/PKE’s.
Experienced Working on ITSM (BMC's Remedy Tool) & familiarized with INFORMATICA tool.

Net Developer

Migrated all the infotech valley web pages from php to .net
Created & worked on user controls like employee login and search.
Created login control in asp.net using C# where user can create his own account, roles.
Worked on visual studio 2005.

Worked on database SQL server 2005.
Created Tables, Views, Triggers, Indexes, Constraints and functions in SQL server
Worked on Integration of UI interface with SQL Server 2005 database.
Projects
Worked On: -
Verizon Data Services, Tampa, Florida
Relevant Projects:
Designed Using Simulink 1G Hz Scope and Spectrum                                                                March 2007
Simulated the design as per the requirement.
Simulink is integrated with mat lab.
Observed signal and its spectrum.
Designed Application of Fuzzy Logic Controller                                                          Oct 2007
Simulated the design using transfer function.
Developed mat lab code for Fuzzify, PFLC, PDFLC.
Using Fuzzy Logic controller and Fuzzy sets, we can make the given system STABLE.
Case Study Presentation                                                                                                Sept 2007- March 2008
Case study presentation on Bio-Dynamics
Case study presentation on Bio-Thermodynamics
Presented In class Term Paper on Ergonomics Engineering
Dissertation: Measurement of moisture using capacitive method

The objective of our project is to determine the moisture content in paper by a capacitive type of sensor. The capacitance principle was used to determine the moisture content. We also studied the different methods used in paper industry to determine the moisture content. To achieve this, complete design and drawing of different parts has been made under guidance of project guide. The fabrication is made as per the design drawing. Made industrial visit to Pudamji pulp and paper products at Pune, India.

Designing the GUI for the applications.
Involved in design and development phase
Designing and coding Forms
Code reviews and estimation

Worked on 3 tier Architectures.
Worked on Telerik controls.
Enhancements to the application

Using ADO.Net for accessing and modifying the stored data from SQL Server 2008
Visual Source Safe has been used for all the source code maintenance among the whole team members.
Involved in Unit testing, integration testing and performance tuning

Visual Studio 2008/10, .Net 3.5/4.0, C#.Net, SQL Server 2008, VSS, TFS2010

Dot Net Developer                                                                      from March 2011 to Oct 2011

Humana is a fortune 100 company which offers insurance. It markets health insurance products. Humana offers mail-order facility which is RightSourceRx. This home-delivery service is available to all Humana members. It has a national mail order retail pharmacy.
Responsibilities: -
Worked on RAT application which is used for allocating working hours and over time to associates working on Rxs and Orders.
Worked on enhancement and correcting defects in the application.
Have successfully done data archive and purge for production data and tried to maintain the latency on database.
Worked on SSIS package.
Worked on Verint project where i was involved in writing complex stored procedures for creating data feeds.
Hands on experience on SYBASE.
Wrote complex stored procedure.
Designed windows-based forms using C#.Net
Extensively worked on Data fixing and Bug fixing.

Worked on Integration of UI interface with SQL Server 2008 database
Used Team Foundation Server 2010(TFS) for version controlling.

Visual Studio 2008/10, .Net 3.5, C#.Net, ASP.net, SQL Server 2008, SYBASE, VSS, TFS2010

Dot Net Developer                                                                                              from July 2010 to February 2011
